avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces posaconazole levels by up to 50%, decreasing antifungal efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin/Rifabutin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducers significantly reduce posaconazole plasma concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Do not combine; use alternative antitubercular agents if possible

avoid_supplements.name: Phenytoin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer decreases posaconazole bioavailability and therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination or monitor antifungal levels closely with dose adjustment

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4, potentially reducing posaconazole concentration

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing posaconazole levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for signs of toxicity; may require dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 effects with unclear clinical significance
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor clinical response

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases posaconazole bioavailability and risk of adverse effects

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Delayed gastric emptying may enhance oral posaconazole absorption (suspension formulation dependent)
caution_foods.action: Take oral suspension with food for optimal absorption; IV formulation unaffected

caution_foods.name: Acidic beverages (cola, orange juice)
caution_foods.mechanism: Suspension formulation requires acidic environment for optimal dissolution
caution_foods.action: May take with acidic drinks to enhance absorption of suspension formulation

monitoring_notes: Monitor for QT prolongation risk, especially with concurrent CYP3A4 inhibitors or in patients with electrolyte abnormalities. Ensure adequate gastric acidity for oral suspension absorption; monitor serum levels and antifungal efficacy during treatment.
